editorial:
Imagine spending your whole day around dead bodies in a quiet New York City basement. That is exactly how the main character lives his life until one day, a body arrives that looks exactly like him. It is a wild setup that turns a boring job into a strange mystery. You will feel the tension as he tries to figure out who this other man is and why they share the same face. The vibe is very moody and strange, making you feel like something weird is about to happen at any second.

The acting is solid and keeps you invested even when the plot slows down. While it is not an action-packed film, the weirdness of the situation keeps you guessing. One downside is that it moves a bit slow in the middle, but the payoff is worth it. If you like odd stories that make you think about life and death, you should definitely check this out. You can rent it on Apple TV for a quick watch, or if you want the best picture quality, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your collection is the way to go.
endingExplained: The movie wraps up by revealing that the double was not just a random coincidence. It turns out the story is more about the man facing his own fears and regrets. He realizes that seeing his double was a wake-up call to stop living like a ghost. He finally decides to change his life and find some happiness, leaving the mystery of the double as a catalyst for his own personal growth.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves strange stories about identity and mystery.
